purpose:
This report seeks approval of the
attached ‘Supplemental Enforcement Policy (Renters Rights Act
2025)’ and ‘Civil Penalties Policy under the
Renters’ Rights Act 2025 and other housing
legislation’. The Act introduces a new suite of new powers
for the council, these powers come into force from 1 May 2026 up to
2035. To use the powers the council must publish a policy setting
out how we will implement these powers in relation to the private
rented properties. This report also includes process mapping and a
triage framework that indicate how the council will manage incoming
enquiries arising from the Act.

purpose:
This report
summarises the action the Council needs to take to continue with
the existing contracts for energy procurement through Government
Commercial Agency (GCA) framework. The Council will be able to
continue to use the GCA framework for the provision of gas and
electricity for up to a further 3 years from 1 April 2027 to 31
March 2030 under appropriate terms. The direct award will enable
the provision of electricity for the period from 1 April 2027 to 31
March 2030 for an estimated total sum of £40 million
exclusive of VAT. And for the provision of gas for the period from
1 April 2027 to 31 March 2030 for an estimated total sum of
£23 million exclusive of VAT.

purpose:

requirement.
